name: Job Search App — Auto-fill
description: Auto-fills ATS application forms (Greenhouse, Workable, Workday, iCIMS, Ashby, ADP, etc.) from your Job Search App profile. Rule-based fill for the common fields, plus AI-filled custom free-text questions when the server has ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set. Auto-fires on supported ATS hosts with a toast + Undo. You always review + click Submit yourself.
